caption: The drawing depicts two detailed views of a Victorian-era dress, shown in a naturalistic style. The larger view on the right displays the front of the dress, while the smaller view on the left shows the back. The dress is composed of a fitted bodice in a medium brown color, with a buttoned front and a high neckline, and features long sleeves with ruffled cuffs. The bodice has a peplum effect at the waist. The skirt, which is attached to the bodice, is full and gathered, rendered in a pale beige or tan color with extensive crinkling and ruching, and it is decorated with several bands and trims in darker brown. The hem and borders of the skirt have scalloped and ruffled details. The back view reveals further decoration and gathering, and the bodice appears to be slightly longer in the back, ending in a soft point. Both views are set against a plain, light background, and the artist’s name, Max Imsar, is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Wedding Dress
